answer: The protocol requires each validator to lock staking collateral C that scales quadratically with weight, so a Sybil cluster of n identities faces capital cost O(n^2). Super-linear slashing penalties lambda>1 multiply each bond and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay V forces sequential work, making expected utility U=R-C*lambda^n-V negative for any reward R. Consequently a robust Nash equilibrium emerges where deviation is dominated, securing consensus even if an adversary launches a timber island voyage of coordinated nodes.
